description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Gdpr' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. It contains methods for managing GDPR-related data such as adding new GDPR records, updating status, and retrieving GDPR records by ID, code, or email.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for handling GDPR-related database operations such as adding, updating, and retrieving GDPR records.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Inserts a new GDPR record into the database with provided code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its ID.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records with status '2' and older than a certain number of days, based on configuration.
